Both floors moved DOWN this commit: unit 63.05 -> 61.92, full 70.29 -> 68.62. Cause: the review-harvest feature added src/hebrew_cards/review.py (well covered, 10 unit tests) alongside scripts/harvest_review.py (~50 statements, 0% covered — scripts/ is measured but CLI entry points here have no direct tests). The untested script outweighs the tested module in the ratio. This is the same structural issue as extract_collection.py and build_decks.py, both also at 0%: the project measures scripts/ but tests the library modules those scripts call. Worth revisiting by testing the CLI layer via subprocess or main() calls, which would raise the floor meaningfully. Recorded because the policy requires a lowered floor to state its cause. Raise only via `python scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same commit that earns the increase, never by hand.
